title: AI Engineer Career Roadmap
tagline: From Python & Math fundamentals to Autonomous Agents & Production LLM Infrastructure
description: Designed for developers transitioning into AI Engineering. Focuses on building practical AI systems, prompt engineering, vector databases, RAG, and agentic workflows.

stages.name: Python & CS Fundamentals
stages.description: Master modern Python 3.12+, async/await, typing, data structures, OOP, and REST APIs.

stages.name: Mathematics for AI
stages.description: Linear algebra basics, matrix multiplication, vector spaces, derivatives, probability & Bayes theorem.

stages.name: Data Manipulation & SQL
stages.description: Pandas, NumPy array operations, data cleaning, parquet, PostgreSQL, and vector embeddings.

stages.name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
stages.description: Supervised vs Unsupervised learning, Scikit-Learn pipelines, Decision Trees, Gradient Boosting.

stages.name: Deep Learning & PyTorch
stages.description: Neural network architectures, Backpropagation, Autograd, PyTorch Tensors, DataLoaders, and GPUs.

stages.name: Transformers & NLP
stages.description: Self-attention mechanism, Multi-Head Attention, BERT, GPT, Hugging Face Transformers library.

stages.name: LLM Fundamentals & Prompt Engineering
stages.description: Tokenization, context windows, zero-shot/few-shot prompting, system instructions, and structured output.

stages.name: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
stages.description: Chunking strategies, Vector Databases (Chroma, Qdrant, Pinecone), Hybrid Search, BM25, and Reranking.

stages.name: Autonomous AI Agents
stages.description: ReAct framework, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI), memory stores, and tool calling.

stages.name: PEFT & Fine-Tuning
stages.description: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning using LoRA, QLoRA, SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning), DPO, and Unsloth.

stages.name: MLOps & LLMOps
stages.description: Model serving (vLLM, Ollama, TensorRT-LLM), observability (LangSmith, Phoenix), and CI/CD for AI.

stages.name: AI System Design & Production
stages.description: Designing end-to-end resilient AI microservices, rate limiting, caching semantic results, and cost guardrails.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Roadmap
tagline: Mathematical rigor, algorithmic deep-dives, and production ML pipelines
description: Tailored for engineers who want to focus on building, training, evaluating, and deploying custom ML models at scale.

stages.name: Linear Algebra & Calculus
stages.description: Vector spaces, matrix decomposition, gradients, optimization algorithms.

stages.name: Statistical Machine Learning
stages.description: Probabilistic modeling, Naive Bayes, SVMs, Decision Trees, Ensemble methods.

stages.name: Deep Learning & Computer Vision
stages.description: CNNs, Residual Networks (ResNet), object detection, and Vision Transformers.

stages.name: ML Operations (MLOps)
stages.description: Data pipelines, MLflow, feature stores, model monitoring, and automated retraining.
